SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.Certificate {m : ℕ} (family : NumStability.DirectionalLine.LineFamily m)
  (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ) (p L : ℝ) : Type

SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.certificate_exists {m : ℕ} (family : NumStability.DirectionalLine.LineFamily m)
  (quality : family.HasControlledHighResolution) :
  ∃ p L,
    1 < p ∧
      0 ≤ L ∧
        ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ),
          NumStability.LocalConservationLaw.SpatialSmoothReferenceOn q family.flux family.states family.left
              family.right family.horizon →
            Nonempty (SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.Certificate family q p L)

SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.scalar_cfl1_certificate :
  ∃ p L,
    1 < p ∧
      0 ≤ L ∧
        ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin 1 → ℝ),
          NumStability.LocalConservationLaw.SpatialSmoothReferenceOn q
              (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1).flux
              (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1).states
              (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1).left
              (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1).right
              (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1).horizon →
            Nonempty
              (SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.Certificate (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1) q p L)

SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.scalar_nonconstant_reference_certificate :
  ∃ p L,
    1 < p ∧
      0 ≤ L ∧
        Nonempty
          (SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.Certificate (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1)
            (fun x t => NumStability.CFLUnitShift.smoothProfile (x - t)) p L)

SharedAccuracyCertificateDraft.cinfty_definition {m : ℕ} (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ) (flux : ℝ → (Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ)
  (states : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (a b T : ℝ) :
  NumStability.LocalConservationLaw.SpatialSmoothReferenceOn q flux states a b T ↔
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (Function.uncurry q) (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
      NumStability.LocalConservationLaw.SpatialRectangleReferenceOn q flux a b T ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, q x t ∈ states
